subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should an authorized workflow/security owner approve these exact third-party action revisions for workflows that pass GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and an OpenAI API key?
rationale: The repository policy treats dependency-backed and secret-bearing execution-path changes as requiring direct contract inspection and explicit owner judgment; a review worker cannot safely substitute for that authorization.

options.title: Audit and approve exact revisions
options.body: Review upstream source or release provenance for the pinned action SHAs, record approval, and merge only after the rebased head and required checks pass.

options.title: Split non-secret action updates
options.body: Land only independently audited non-secret workflow action updates and defer the credential-bearing action revisions to a separately approved PR.

options.title: Pause this dependency group
options.body: Close or defer the automated group update if no owner is available to accept its supply-chain boundary.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve exact revisions
recommendation.body: Review upstream source or release provenance for the pinned action SHAs, record approval, and merge only after the rebased head and required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The security-routing automation is the only concrete owner-adjacent signal present in the supplied context; a human workflow/security owner should make the final decision.
